column1: # Game profile of Art of Rally (Switch, update 1.1.9 = v458752)
# PEANUTS: a Peanuts Native profile (Banana Native has none for this title); whole file Peanuts' own
# Unity 2019.4.40f1 (IL2CPP) with FMOD, SDK 13.3.2, NVN. Began from Subnautica: Below Zero's profile (Unity 2019.4, SDK 13.3.5); the engine generation matches, the SDK and update do not.
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource, so IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is true: nninitStartup hands application pool − used memory to
# StandardAllocator as virtual address memory and never calls SetHeapSize. The 1 GB pool copied from Ace Attorney (measured for that Unity 2022.3
# game) gave StandardAllocator only a 0.94 GB address region: loading a race used it up, a 2 MB request returned null and the game wrote at
# null+0xd44b0 (SIGSEGV main+0x7686bc, Lenovo TB321FU, 2026-11-19). The pool is the Switch's hardware 3285 MiB, as most profiles.
# With it StandardAllocator's region is 3.14 GB (1.01 GB mapped) and the game's other address regions reached +4.25 GB of the 4.375 GB alias
# region, 0.13 GB short of room for other locations; the block is 6 GB (the iOS reservation limit, as in the 5 GB one), giving the alias region 1 GB more.
# The map limit stays on (the default): with the hardware pool the physical alias mappings peaked at 2.00 GB of 3.21 GB, so no map is refused.
# (With the 1 GB pool they reached 0.94 GB and MapPhysicalMemory was refused, ResultLimitReached, aborting a race at sdk+0x16ba48.)
# PEANUTS: the game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode(near = 0) (log: "depth mode near=0", Lenovo TB321FU, 2026-11-19)
# The game sets present interval 1 → 2 (30 fps). Unity times its logic in seconds, so presenting every display tick runs it at 60 fps at normal speed,
# as Hong Kong Massacre's profile does (checked on the tablet, Turnip)
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; Unity Shader and ComputeShader objects, read by unityfs.py) ----
